
---
title: "M1 Static Dashboard - Violent Crime in Buffalo, New York"
subtitle: "M1 · 2021–2025"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: scroll
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(lubridate)
library(tigris)
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.explore)
library(terra)
library(plotly)

# Read crime incidents
raw <- read_csv("data/buffalo_crime_incidents.csv",
                show_col_types = FALSE)

# Keep selected violent crime categories
violent_types <- c("Assault", "Robbery", "Sexual Offense",
                   "Homicide", "SODOMY")

violent_raw <- raw |>
  filter(`Parent Incident Type` %in% violent_types) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(`Incident Date`, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    lon = as.numeric(Longitude),
    lat = as.numeric(Latitude)) |>
  filter(!is.na(date),
         date >= as.Date("2021-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2025-12-31"))

# Buffalo city boundary
area <- places(state = "NY", cb = TRUE, year = 2020,
               progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  filter(NAME == "Buffalo") |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Convert crime incidents to points
pts <- violent_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_filter(area)

# Number of selected incidents excluded from spatial analysis
n_excluded <- nrow(violent_raw) - nrow(pts)

n_excluded


```

Column {data-width=500}
-------------------------------------

### Kernel density of violent crime · Buffalo, 2021–2025

```{r kde-map}
# Buffalo boundary to coordinates
area_utm <- st_transform(area, 32617) |>
  st_geometry()

pts_utm <- st_transform(pts, 32617)

# point pattern
win_buffalo <- as.owin(area_utm)
pp_all <- as.ppp(st_geometry(pts_utm))
Window(pp_all) <- win_buffalo

# Kernel density estimation
kde_km <- density(pp_all, sigma = 600, eps = 100) * 1e6

m <- kde_km$v
m <- m[nrow(m):1, ]

kde_r <- rast(nrows = nrow(m), ncols = ncol(m),
              xmin = kde_km$xrange[1], xmax = kde_km$xrange[2],
              ymin = kde_km$yrange[1], ymax = kde_km$yrange[2],
              crs = "EPSG:32617",
              vals = as.vector(t(m)))

pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = values(kde_r),
                    na.color = "transparent")

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.StamenToner) |>
  addRasterImage(kde_r, colors = pal, opacity = 0.55) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal, values = values(kde_r),
            title = "Incidents per km<sup>2</sup>",
            position = "bottomright")
```

> Darker colors indicate higher estimated densities of recorded incidents per km² across 2021–2025. These are incident densities, not population-adjusted crime risks.

Column {data-width=400}

### Violent crime incident locations · Buffalo, 2021–2025

```{r point-map, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# point map 

leaflet(pts) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.StamenToner) |>
  addPolygons(data = area, fill = FALSE,
              color = "blue", weight = 2) |>
  addCircleMarkers(radius = 1, stroke = FALSE,
                   fillOpacity = 0.5,
                   color = "#B2182B",
                   label = ~as.character(date))
```

> Each point represents a recorded incident. Overlapping points can hide repeated incidents at the same location.

### Monthly violent crime incidents · Buffalo, 2021–2025

```{r monthly-chart, fig.width=6, fig.height=2.5}
# for monthly chart
by_month <- pts |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  count(month = lubridate::floor_date(date, "month"))   # cases per month

p <- ggplot(by_month, aes(month, n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases per month") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)


```

> Monthly bars show the number of recorded incidents with valid dates and locations inside Buffalo, not population-adjusted crime rates.

### About these data

- **Outcome:** Chose to report on violent crime categories (assault, robbery, sexual offense, sodomy, homicide), 2021–2025.
- **Geography:** Buffalo, New York - individual incident locations
- **Source:** [Buffalo Open Data — Crime Incidents](https://data.buffalony.gov/Public-Safety/Crime-Incidents/d6g9-xbgu/about_data).
- **Boundary:** 2020 U.S. Census city boundary, accessed through tigris.
- **Population at risk:** No total population was used, maps show locations and density, not risk.
- **Missing data:** 61 lines were excluded from analysis because missing coordinates or locations
  outside of Buffalo.
- **Limitation:** The incidents here probably do not represent all crimes that occurred, just the ones reported. Also did not include property crimes.

### AI use note

ChatGPT was used to decide ESPG, help filter for violent_types and violent_raw.
